title: Store Credit Awards Set Against a Circle Sweep Pool
content:
## Value the member has already had for the points

Points the member has already had the value of are set against the pool a sweep would take on a Northbeam
Circle Membership. The value in question is store credit posted as a promotional award to the account the
profile holds under Northbeam Store Credit and Financing Accounts.

1. Where that credit account stands active and store credit was posted to it as a promotional award in the
   twelve months ending on the handling day, the points set against the pool on that account are what the
   awards posted in that window are worth at the tier's value per hundred points.
2. Where that account stands active and awards were posted to it only earlier than that window, the points
   set against the pool on that account are what the awards posted over the whole ledger are worth at the same
   rate.
3. Where neither of those holds, nothing is set against the pool on that account, and 0 points are taken off
   for value already had.

## How money posted is read as points

The awards are converted at the tier's value per hundred points: the money posted is divided by that value and
the figure taken times one hundred, giving a whole number of points rounded to the nearest point.

| Tier | Value of 100 points (USD) | Points a hypothetical award of 27.50 is worth |
|---|---|---|
| Circle Free Membership | 0.50 | 5500 |
| Circle Plus Annual | 0.75 | 3667 |
| Circle Total Annual | 1.00 | 2750 |
| Circle Total Household Annual | 1.00 | 2750 |
| Circle Business Pro | 1.10 | 2500 |
| Circle Business Elite | 1.25 | 2200 |

## Cases

A credit account standing active with a promotional award of 27.50 posted last month, held by a member on
Circle Total Household Annual, sets 2750 points against the pool. The same account with its only award posted three
years ago falls to the second reading, and the awards posted over the whole ledger are converted at the same
rate. A credit account that does not stand active sets nothing against the pool, whatever awards stand posted
to it.
